sources.summary: Owner-approved single-reader save/find/mark-read outcome; preserve title and address; exclude accounts, sharing and recommendations.
Local Node application, JSON persistence, queue save/list/mark-read operations; presentation never writes storage directly.
Queue includes read articles; marking read preserves title and address.
Only three documents; no implementation, manifests, native configurations, check command or CI. Clean revision from inspect.
Documents provide enough direction for implementation, but no product readiness or successful journey can be established.

findings.problem: The approved save/list/mark-read journey has no runnable application or executable protection.
findings.principle: Deliver the approved journey while preserving article title/address and retaining read articles in the queue. Existing approved requirement, not a new principle.
findings.consequence: There is no evidence that the first-version success outcome or JSON persistence works. This blocks a product readiness claim, not this recommendations-only audit.
findings.fix: When implementation is selected, implement the existing queue public operations and local JSON adapter behind presentation. Add one direct journey check using an isolated temporary JSON file: save an article, list it, mark it read, list it again, reopen storage and confirm read status plus the exact original title/address. Keep it visible after marking read. Do not add excluded product features.
findings.verification: Use VISION.md:5, DESIGN.md:3-6 and glossary.md:4-5 as acceptance sources. Run the real presentation-to-queue-to-JSON journey with temporary storage, including reopening, and retain output/exit on final inputs. No mocks or private-helper assertions. Read-status/title/address losses must fail. No exception to the approved preserved-data outcome.

findings.problem: DESIGN.md defines responsibilities but no completion evidence or maintained check command.
findings.principle: Proposed review rule: a change is complete when its affected approved journeys pass on final inputs; unit checks alone cannot establish journey completion.
findings.consequence: Future contributors could claim completion while persistence or presentation bypasses remain unchecked.
findings.fix: Propose one short completion-evidence section in existing DESIGN.md linking the approved acceptance sources, eventual journey check and one repo-owned maintained check command. Review presentation changes against DESIGN.md:5 rather than introducing a speculative architecture checker. Include only configured native checks; choose formatting/lint/type tools when real code justifies them. Do not require this skill or delivery services to run project checks.
findings.verification: After separately reviewed implementation, the maintained command must run the journey successfully and fail on deliberate title/address loss in disposable fixtures. Review presentation code for storage bypasses. Each deferred check must record reason, scope and removal condition; unavailable checks never count as passed. CI remains outside this proposal unless separately selected.

limitations: No native starting-check or executable application exists, so starting-checks and product readiness are verification blocked. Inspect/inventory/cite-check/measure are audit evidence, not application checks.
